items.title: Case 2: [When source of sound moves away from the stationary observer] (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Case 2: [When source of sound moves away from the stationary observer]: a main subheading of 7.11 Doppler effect, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 163-167.

blocks.text: Jab source velocity uₛ se thehre hue observer D se door jata hai to waves phail jati hain aur un ki wavelength barh jati hai. Waves itni amount se expand hoti (phailti) hain:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab expansion (phailao) ki amount ko “λ_D = uₛ/f” likhti hai. Yeh ghalat hai: uₛ/f wavelength ka increase (izafa) Δλ (Doppler shift) hai, D ki wavelength nahi; jaise Case 1 mein Δλ = uₛ/f tha. D ki dekhi hui wavelength λ_D = λ + Δλ = (v + uₛ)/f hai. Kitab yahan aur Case 1 mein figure ko “Fig. 7.13 (c)” aur “Fig. 7.13 (d)” kehti hai; asal mein yeh Case 1 ke saath chhapi Fig. 7.12 hai (kitab ne 7.12 number do baar diya hai); Fig. 7.13 radar wali figure hai jis ke sirf (a) aur (b) hisse hain.
Waves is liye phailti hain ke utni hi waves ab zyada faasle mein samati hain. Observer D ko yeh wavelength milti hai:
Yahan Δλ ek second mein wavelength ka increase hai; ise bhi Doppler shift kehte hain.
Is liye observer D ko ek second mein milne wali waves ki number (apparent frequency):
Yani observer ko sunai dene wali frequency kam ho jati hai, aur sound ki pitch neechi ho jati hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: source qareeb aaye to formula ke neeche (v − uₛ), frequency barhti hai; source door jaye to (v + uₛ), frequency ghatti hai.

blocks.caption: Info Corner: Hearing Ranges (sunne ki range)

blocks.title: Do You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Jab hawai jahaz tez hota hai to apne aage hawa ko dhakel kar hawa ke pressure (dabao) ki ek deewar si bana leta hai. Jab woh sound ki speed se aage nikal jata hai to yeh pressure boat ki wake (kashti ke peeche bante nishaan) ki tarah peeche reh jata hai aur sonic shockwave banti hai.

blocks.alt: Teen hawai jahaz apne sound ke wavefronts ke sath. (a) Subsonic speed: gol wavefronts naak se aage rehte hain. (b) Sound ki speed par: wavefronts naak par jama ho kar charh jate hain (Overlapping). (c) Supersonic speed: wavefronts peeche ek cone ke andar rehte hain jis ke kinare Shockwave hain. Wavefront ke labels dairon ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Do You Know? (PDF page 165): sound ki speed se kam, barabar aur zyada par jahaz aur shockwave (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab (a) par bhi 'Supersonic speed' likhti hai, magar (a) mein wavefronts jahaz se aage hain, yani jahaz sound se aahista hai: sahih lafz 'Subsonic speed' hai, jo yahan likha gaya hai. (b) mein jahaz sound ki speed par hai, wavefronts naak par jama; (c) mein jahaz sound se tez hai aur wavefronts ka cone shockwave (sonic boom) banata hai.

blocks.title: Example 7.10
blocks.problem: Do trucks P aur Q motorway par ek hi direction (simt) mein chal rahe hain. Aage wala truck P 12 m s⁻¹ ki constant (mustaqil) speed se hai; peeche wala truck Q 20 m s⁻¹ ki constant speed se chalte hue horn bajata hai, jis ki frequency P ka driver 830 Hz estimate (andaza) karta hai. Q ka apna driver kaunsi frequency sunta hai? (Sound ki speed = 340 m s⁻¹)
steps: Diya gaya: u_P = 12 m s⁻¹, u_Q = 20 m s⁻¹, v = 340 m s⁻¹, f_P = 830 Hz; f_Q = ?
Q (source) P (listener) ki taraf relative speed se aa raha hai: uₛ = u_Q − u_P = 20 − 12 = 8 m s⁻¹.
Qareeb aate source ka formula: f_P = (v/(v − uₛ)) f_Q. Q ka driver source ke saath chal raha hai, is liye woh asal frequency f_Q sunta hai.

blocks.alt: Daen rukh do trucks: peeche surmai truck Q, Source (20 m s^-1), aur aage neela truck P, Listener (12 m s^-1).
blocks.caption: Example 7.10 (PDF page 166): peeche truck Q source 20 m s⁻¹, aage truck P sunne wala 12 m s⁻¹ (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Example 7.11
blocks.problem: Station se chalne se pehle train horn bajati hai aur platform par khara observer us ki frequency 1200 Hz andaza karta hai. Phir train chal parti hai aur steadily (ek jaisi rate se) tez hoti hai. Departure (rawangi) ke 50 second baad driver phir horn bajata hai aur platform wala observer frequency 1140 Hz andaza karta hai. 50 s baad train ki speed nikalein, aur 50 s baad train station se kitni door hai? (Sound ki speed = 340 m s⁻¹)
steps: Diya gaya: asal frequency f = 1200 Hz, apparent frequency f′ = 1140 Hz, v = 340 m s⁻¹, t = 50 s; uₛ = ?, S = ?
(i) Train door ja rahi hai: f′ = (v/(v + uₛ)) f, yani 1140 = (340/(340 + uₛ)) × 1200.
(ii) Train rest se steadily tez hui, is liye average speed = (vᵢ + v_f)/2 = (0 + 17.89)/2 = 8.945 m s⁻¹.
blocks.answer: Train ki speed 17.89 m s⁻¹ aur faasla 448 m.

blocks.title: Do You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Bats (chamgadar) echolocation se raasta aur khana dhoondte hain: woh oonchi frequency ki sound nikalte hain aur cheezon se lautne wali echo (goonj) sunte hain.

blocks.alt: Halki gaar (cave) ki chhat se ulta latka horseshoe chamgadar: sunehri-bhoora roondar jism tah kiye paron mein lipta, oopar panje chhat ko pakre, aur neeche sar par do bare nokeele kaan, chhoti kaali aankhen aur gulabi ghore ki naal jaisi naak.
blocks.caption: Chamgadar echo location (goonj) se raasta aur khana dhoondte hain (kitab ki chhapi tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.prompt: Ek train 90 km h⁻¹ par 1000 Hz ki seeti bajati hui station ki taraf aati hai; platform par khara shakhs kaunsi frequency sunta hai, aur usi speed se door jate hue kaunsi (numerical 7.10)? Source observer ke relative kaise chale ke frequency na badle (constructed response 7.4)?
blocks.explanation: 90 km h⁻¹ = 25 m s⁻¹ (v = 340 m s⁻¹ lein). Qareeb aate hue: f = (340/(340 − 25)) × 1000 = 1079.4 Hz; door jate hue: f = (340/(340 + 25)) × 1000 = 931.5 Hz. Frequency tab nahi badalti jab source aur observer ko milane wali line ke saath koi relative motion na ho: jaise source observer ke gird circle (daire) mein chale, ya dono ek hi velocity se saath chalein (jaise musafir apni hi gaari ka horn sune).

items: Doppler effect: source aur observer ki relative motion se frequency (pitch) ki apparent tabdeeli; aaram mein f = v/λ.
Source qareeb aaye: Δλ = uₛ/f, λ_C = (v − uₛ)/f, f_C = [v/(v − uₛ)] f > f (pitch oonchi).
Source door jaye: λ_D = (v + uₛ)/f, f_D = [v/(v + uₛ)] f < f (pitch neechi).
Example 7.10: f_Q = 810.47 Hz. Example 7.11: uₛ = 17.89 m s⁻¹, S = 448 m.
